title: Area 50 ± 1.1 cm²
caption: The relative uncertainties 1% and 2% combine to 2.24%, so δA ≈ 1.1 cm². The area 50.0 cm² could lie anywhere from 48.9 to 51.1 cm², which the lesson reports as 50 ± 1 cm².
alt: A number line from 47 to 53 with the point 50 and the interval from 48.9 to 51.1 marked.
description: So the area lies between 48.9 and 51.1 cm².
